description: This file contains CMake functions for processing JSON strings, including removing quotes, escaping characters, and converting JSON strings to CMake strings.

methods.name: json_string_to_cmake
methods.description: Processes a JSON string to remove quotes and escape special characters, returning a cleaned CMake string.

methods.name: json_string_ref_to_cmake
methods.description: Converts a reference to a JSON string into a CMake string by invoking json_string_to_cmake.
